name: zpp-connect
description: ZPP Connect - Family Assistance, Next-of-Kin Matching and Reunification Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @zpp/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @zpp/api" "npm run dev -w @zpp/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev && npm run test:smoke
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zpp/shared && npm run build -w @zpp/api && npm run build -w @zpp/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @zpp/api && npm run lint -w @zpp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @zpp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @zpp/api && npm run typecheck -w @zpp/web
